notes: Hand-written expected. Production extracted this receipt correctly but it matched an event the user had declined a month earlier (before they decided to go), so the 'declined is terminal' rule recorded it and nothing reached the calendar. The fix needs the extractor to say the user bought tickets: booking_confirmed true. The two identical ticket lines are one performance, so one event.
